sloka: नृषद्गुः कवषो धौम्यो रौद्रेयश्च महानृषिः ।ते ऽप्याजग्मुः सशिष्या वै ये श्रिताः पश्चिमां दिशम् ।। ७.१.४ ॥
transliteration: nṛṣadguḥ kavaṣo dhaumyo raudreyaśca mahānṛṣiḥ ।te 'pyājagmuḥ saśiṣyā vai ye śritāḥ paścimāṁ diśam ।। 7.1.4 ॥

translations.english: Nṛṣadgu, Kavaṣa, Dhaumya, and the great sage Raudreya, who resided in the western direction, also came with their disciples.
